owner_scope: 2026-10-24: complete step 3 with Sol 6.1 Max; Astra fallback only if the judgment is inadequate
original_headline: TR-B still fails the frozen supported-increment rule; retrospective execution is valid but does not establish deployable value
single_successor_question: With the existing 20% unit-scoped entry cap and full held-risk policy fixed, does removing only the strategy-level entry veto improve the complete portfolio return/drawdown tradeoff relative to TR?

proposed_candidate.only_policy_change: Abstain from the position-risk STRATEGY BLOCK_NEW for threshold exceedance; preserve its feature requirements and the 20% constraint
proposed_candidate.held_policy: Exact existing policy, including at most one strategy reduction per new position and the conjunctive extreme exit; corrected P2 accounting-v2

invariants: Identical P4 candidate generator, Trend scoring, ordering and common complete-case mask
RSI14 and volatility20 remain required even when the heuristic strategy veto abstains
Missing, invalid, ambiguous or PIT-unavailable input blocks new entries; it does not force an existing position sale
All system vetoes, tradability, funding, concentration, Decimal and source lineage remain active
The 20% unit entry constraint applies to every eligible candidate, including values beyond the old heuristic thresholds
Unchanged full held policy, base exits, corrected cash/dividend/reduction-count accounting, P2 costs and matching
T close decision and first eligible T+1 open execution; no intraday or email fill inference
Exact acquisition/publication/effective/knowledge timestamps and 4173 unavailable semantics remain unchanged
why_this_question: Step2 did not identify the entry filter effect with held risk active at the same 20% cap
This adds one previously unmeasured cell; it does not pick the highest-return observed cell
Keeping cap and held risk avoids combining rule removals or changing TH's 30%-to-10% intervention amplitude
Actual average exposure, cash use and timing may still differ; these are policy-path effects to report, not equal-risk alpha ownership

not_selected.promote_T_TC_or_TH: Already observed diagnostics and different risk/capital paths do not qualify a winner
not_selected.retune_RSI_or_volatility: No threshold search; only a complete, explicit removal of one policy effect is proposed
not_selected.repeat_five_cells: Accepted unchanged evidence is reused; repeating it does not resolve the missing conditional contrast
not_selected.add_experts_or_exposure_matching_platfor: No demonstrated beneficiary justifies a broader research/platform programme

Separate exact execution receipts for both roles and a newly recorded access decision
TR reproduces every retained business anchor before TCH starts
Actual mount/device capacity and current job remnants included in a write-before budget

minimum_implementation.admission: New request/card/mapping/runtime IDs and an initially empty exact primary/cold execution registry; old receipt hashes cannot grant access
minimum_implementation.policy_anchor: At every common input context TCH entry business fields must equal TC entry policy; this is a same-context pure policy check, not a third portfolio replay
synthetic_regressions: RSI/volatility threshold exceedance removes only STRATEGY BLOCK_NEW
Held/base exits, dividend cash flows and new-position reduction counter preserved

engineering_acceptance: All decisions and complete portfolio cash/position/fee/dividend flows reconcile
Raw replay digests recomputed; exact recorded key/version/input identities match
Fresh cold process denies original-source access and network, then reproduces all business outputs under exact identity mappings

analysis.interval: Descriptive unadjusted 95% percentile; fixed SHA256(new request semantic digest + ':TCH-TR') seed
analysis.trailing_dates: Included in full-window points, excluded only from incomplete-block resampling and listed explicitly
analysis.inference: A registered complete-policy intervention at fixed cap/held rules; no claim of exposure-matched alpha or fixed component responsibility

business_screen.source: Reuse the original 1-percentage-point business scale; it is not derived from Step2 points
business_screen.pass_meaning: At most prioritize an independently authorized fresh pilot; never accept a strategy from the exposed window
business_screen.otherwise: Close the successor attempt as no material justification or inconclusive; no new cells, threshold search or window change

budget.implementation_overrun_exit: Stop with a concrete deferred design/implementation finding; no new generic platform or automatic budget increase

stop: Identity, timestamp, input, mask, guardian or accounting drift
Cold reproduction or independent cash-flow failure
Only a changed threshold/window/additional cell could produce the desired conclusion

B_fresh_evidence_pilot.purpose: Finite prospective feasibility/descriptive evidence, not a pre-approved confirmatory or production experiment
entry_gate: Stage A yields a business reason to continue, with all negative and interval evidence retained
Owner separately activates one frozen new request/card/input/consumer version and budget before results
Exposure ledger proves no earlier results were used; later calendar dates alone do not establish freshness
Exact listing/calendar/field-level historical availability and required corporate-action/state support meet the intended consumer gate
First decision is strictly after the frozen activation time; actual dates resolved once from the authoritative calendar
Both arms share a preregistered complete-case mask, same cold-capable reader and P2 semantics; no P6 infrastructure or ledger is reused
B_fresh_evidence_pilot.window_rule: First 66 scheduled decision sessions after activation, plus the one next-open execution boundary; end date fixed once before any result access
B_fresh_evidence_pilot.missing_session_rule: Keep scheduled sessions in the denominator; block new entries and disclose missing data; never skip or extend the horizon to replace them
B_fresh_evidence_pilot.historical_context: Warmup is input-only and must be qualified; historical industry/static-source limitations are disclosed and never relabeled PIT
B_fresh_evidence_pilot.review: One end-of-window economic review; interim access limited to input/engine integrity without performance selection
B_fresh_evidence_pilot.power: Three blocks are not claimed adequate for confirmatory power; report descriptive points and uncertainty/insufficiency

budget.qualification_expiry_exit: DATA_UNAVAILABLE_FOR_PILOT; no implicit P10 delivery promise or automatic investigation extension
budget.scope: Incremental successor consumer work, not permission to modify or start P10 acquisition or P6 jobs

B_fresh_evidence_pilot.budget_rule: These are proposed ceilings, not measurements or authority. Bind per-day and final cold-run actual input/output bytes, total/new file counts, maximum simultaneous live files, inode safety reserve, runtime, disk and device before activation; available inodes must cover worst-case new files plus the frozen reserve; the cumulative cap applies even when separate stage maxima cannot all be used; no blanket migration or resource authorization
B_fresh_evidence_pilot.hard_exit: At 66 sessions close as engineering-valid descriptive, data-limited or inconclusive; no automatic extension, promotion or demand for a positive result
B_fresh_evidence_pilot.confirmatory_followup: Any longer confirmatory study requires its own effect/power rationale, non-exposed scope, exact data authority, cost cap and activation

astra_fallback.trigger: Unresolved evidence/semantic contradiction or an independent review rejection after one finite Sol correction within this single-question scope; at most one bounded read-only Astra review
astra_fallback.not_a_trigger: Negative, inconclusive or unprofitable evidence; these are valid outcomes and do not justify model shopping
